title: DynaRev: Benchmarking Web Agents under Dynamic Goal Revision
abstract: arXiv:2610.40133v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Web agents are typically evaluated with goals fully specified before execution and fixed thereafter, whereas real users often revise their requirements during interaction. To study such interactions, we introduce DynaRev, a benchmark of 181 tasks to evaluate web agents under dynamic goal revision. DynaRev uses semantic milestones to deliver revisions at task-defined stages, covers additive revisions, unconditional overrides, and runtime-conditioned overrides, and evaluates correctness, responsiveness, and efficiency through trajectory-grounded evaluation. Five-model evaluations show that agents often satisfy only part of the task requirements, with performance varying across task sources, revision types, and models. Further analyses reveal varied milestone timing, mixed effects of dynamic delivery, and contrasting revision-handling outcomes, with gains from instruction rewriting while preserving browser state and losses from browser rese

translated_title: DynaRev：动态目标修订下的网络智能体基准测试
translated_abstract: 网络智能体通常是在目标于执行前完全给定且此后保持不变的情况下进行评估的，而真实用户往往会在交互过程中修改自己的需求。为了研究这类交互，我们提出了DynaRev，一个包含181个任务的基准测试，用于在动态目标修订场景下评估网络智能体。DynaRev利用语义里程碑在任务定义的阶段传递修订内容，涵盖增量式修订、无条件覆盖和运行时条件覆盖三类修订方式，并通过基于轨迹的评估来衡量正确性、响应性和效率。对五个模型的评估表明，智能体往往只能满足部分任务需求，其性能在不同任务来源、修订类型和模型之间各不相同。进一步分析揭示了里程碑时机的多样性、动态传递的混合效应以及截然不同的修订处理结果——在保留浏览器状态的情况下重写指令能带来收益，而重置浏览器状态则造成损失。
tldr: 本文提出DynaRev基准，通过181个任务在动态目标修订场景下评估网络智能体，发现现有智能体往往只能满足部分需求，且在保留浏览器状态的前提下重写指令能显著提升修订处理效果。
en_tdlr: We introduce DynaRev, a benchmark of 181 tasks for evaluating web agents under dynamic goal revision, revealing that agents often satisfy only part of the requirements and benefit from instruction rewriting while preserving browser state.
